narrative.intro: Hensel Phelps Construction obligated $427M in federal contracts in FY26 to date. Hensel Phelps Construction received 5 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $85.3M, and obligations are up 797.3% year over year. Hensel Phelps Construction recorded obligations of $100M in FY21, $291M in FY22, $55.8M in FY23, $500M in FY24, and $47.5M in FY25. Hensel Phelps Construction shows a sharp rebound in FY26 relative to the prior fiscal year totals, and the current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is still in progress. Use these figures for budgeting, capture planning, or competitive benchmarking when comparing Hensel Phelps Construction to other contractors in construction and infrastructure markets.
